items.source: MultiValueBinding creates a Predicate out of given Path and collection value. Used for specific parameter treatment in QuerydslBindings.
items.translation: MultiValueBinding 根据给定的 Path 和集合值创建 Predicate。它用于在 QuerydslBindings 中进行特定的参数处理。

items.source: Returns the predicate to be applied to the given Path for the given collection value, which will contain all values submitted for the path bind.
items.translation: 返回一个谓词，该谓词将应用于给定的 `Path` 以及对应的集合值；该集合值包含所有提交到路径绑定的值。

items.source: Returns the predicate to be applied to the given Path for the given collection value, which will contain all values submitted for the path bind. If a single value was provided only the collection will consist of exactly one element.
items.translation: 返回一个谓词，该谓词将应用于给定的 `Path` 以处理集合值。此集合包含绑定路径提交的所有值。如果仅提供了一个单一值，则该集合将恰好包含一个元素。

items.source: @FunctionalInterface public interface MultiValueBinding<T extends com.querydsl.core.types.Path<? extends S>, S>
items.translation: @FunctionalInterface public interface MultiValueBinding<T extends com.querydsl.core.types.Path<? extends S>, S>
